about: Fixed benchmark (python smbrl/plan/benchmark.py from the folder above smbrl/, or python -m plan.benchmark from smbrl/): levels disjoint from eval_levels.json held_out; held_out_levels: held-out levels (a subset of eval_levels.json held_out) played in the same run and reported in their own block, to measure generalization (agent.py collects no world-model data and charges no memory there); config = agent.py defaults resolved by plan.benchmark.freeze(), passed as explicit flags; switches = on/off agent.py flags the benchmark always passes (not defaults).
